hypothesis: A general PI agent that can autonomously discover and invoke automatically created data-analysis Skills improves held-out insight quality over the identical agent without a Skill directory.

architecture.shared_loop: Both arms use the same question proposal, evidence collection, validation, sufficiency review, and submission loop.
architecture.only_treatment_difference: The treatment receives a frozen physical Skill directory; the control receives no Skill directory.
architecture.skill_activation: The runtime exposes only the Skill catalog initially. The agent decides whether to call read_skill and whether to execute an allowed Skill script.
forbidden_mechanisms: held-out case literals in Skill runtime files

skill_creation.creator: standalone PI Agent process
skill_creation.input: score-bound source-train episodes and trajectories only
skill_creation.output: physical Skill directories containing SKILL.md plus optional scripts, tests, assets, and references
requirements: executable Skills include an executable test asset
candidate Skills pass structural and training-literal leakage audit

source-train.purpose: Build the creator corpus from existing historical PI trajectories after exact per-prediction v2 rescoring. These trajectories are extraction evidence, not runtime-comparison observations.

source-valid.purpose: Validate physical candidate Skill directories with the autonomous runtime, then freeze only accepted Skills.

source-test.purpose: Primary held-out source-domain comparison; no protocol, prompt, budget, or Skill changes afterward.

target-test.purpose: Cross-benchmark transfer after source-test, without tuning from target-test results.

reporting.primary_estimand: intention-to-treat paired difference between pi-auto-skills and pi-core
reporting.aggregation: Per-system mean and standard deviation, paired case deltas, bootstrap confidence intervals, run-level variance, and cost-normalized quality.
reporting.claim_boundary: Published baselines are contextual. The matched causal comparison is pi-core versus pi-auto-skills under the same autonomous loop and budget.
